extraction.name: Arabic-Nougat
extraction.description: A suite of OCR models designed to convert Arabic book pages into structured Markdown text
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.publisher: Faculty of Engineering Ain Shams University, Cairo, Egypt
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The primary dataset used for training, arabic-img2md, contains 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations. These pairs were generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The dataset was generated using HTML scraped from the Hindawi website
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset was annotated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: All models and datasets are open-sourced
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset provides a valuable resource for further Arabic OCR research
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi’s web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Hallucination in arabic-small-nougat, repetition in larger models, dataset biases, scalability challenges, cross-script generalization, and complex layouts
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning for Arabic OCR and Markdown extraction tasks
